question: In a code language, ‘JEALOUS’ is written as ‘QVZOLFH’, ‘SACRIFICE’ is written as ‘HZXIRURXV’. How will ‘SYMPATHY’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• In JEALOUS → QVZOLFH 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e51a0fdd1b025ef535f4fa2015edd95bd1095448259502e73a90a9ade5f2d4e.png] 
 
 
 
• In SACRIFICE → HZXIRURXV ​
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0cc9ea5978ee4daba0c708e3c6201bd054d429f405f78b4bf49737b59c3c5d6.png] 
 
 
 
• Similarly, In SYMPATHY → ​
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8e7f055eb96d0ce6a82ab9984a84ff5f5e244ccd405638d94bb7bc0b5889902.png] 
 
 

​Hence, "HBNKZGSB" is the correct answer.
